paragraphs.text: Lyssa is a human from an unknown plane who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where she has a bounty outstanding.

Lyssa is a renowned outlaw on Thunder Junction . A human with short black hair and light brown skin, she stands out in her Sterling Company attire. She wears silvery and black and rides a black horse with silver barding, characteristic of the Sterlings' polished style. Lyssa has earned the moniker Sterling Collector , as she is notorious for targeting those who hold significant resources. Her reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by her ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on her back.
